entries.title: Region-agnostic point ledgers (hardened program)
entries.summary: Your on-chain ledgers are now portable across game regions. If any region ever fails, your points and records move safely to a healthy one, so what you earned can never be lost or frozen behind an outage.
details: What is on-chain now (two aspects, both devnet + gasless, players hold 0 SOL): (1) DICE - every roll goes through MagicBlock VRF on the ER (human via the player's delegated dice PDA gfgplayerd signed by the session key; computers via the house sponsor key server-side). The roll result plus entropy seed land in the dice PDA and the roll tx signature is the verifiable proof. (2) REWARDS - a 1st-place win that had a valid on-chain roll fires record_points on the player's points PDA (gfgpoints); it stores total_points, award_count, last_points/last_reason/last_match_ref where last_match_ref = first 8 bytes of the winning roll sig, binding the reward to the exact roll. The record_points tx signature is the authoritative receipt. What stays off-chain: board state, token moves, turns, and Supabase profile totals (aggregation/fallback only).

On-chain points (Scope B, implemented + verified live on devnet): new PlayerPoints ledger account (seed gfgpoints) + initialize_points/delegate_points/record_points instructions on the same delegated gfg-dice program (program id unchanged).

Relay handleDelegate now creates AND delegates BOTH per-player PDAs (dice gfgplayerd + points gfgpoints) in one idempotent call; fresh onboarding = 4 steps ~0.0086 SOL; per-player spend cap default raised 0.005 -> 0.012 SOL (covers two PDAs with margin).

Client recordPoints(points, reason, matchRef): pure gasless ER write (session key signs, 0-SOL player) returning the receipt signature; matchRefFromSignature = first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64; fetchPointsPda reads the player's own ledger; POINT_REASONS.WIN_1ST=1.
win-detection: after the Supabase +100 1st-place award (proof roll gated), fires recordPoints(100, 1, matchRef) as a soft-fail mirror that never blocks the win UX, and logs the receipt explorer link.
Admin tracker lists each wallet's dice PDA AND points PDA (live delegation status); dashboard renders both. Profile page adds "Your on-chain points ledger" card (own account only, gasless read).
Supabase stays aggregation/fallback; the on-chain record is the permanent verifiable layer (re-sync on devnet wipe).
Scope C (parked): on-chain finish-order record so a full game result (1st..4th) is also committed, not just the reward points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-003): Active Tier ladder anchored to the 100-pt 1st-place win. Tier 1 free 1x. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo -> 2x. Tier 3 = 2,500 spendable/mo -> 3x. Tier 4 = 5,000 spendable/mo -> 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400), never stake returns / comp prizes / referral gifts. Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted pts (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so whales can't mint infinite points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-006): SEVEN revenue streams that decide the build order (revenue first, features second). (1) On-ramp: buy spendable points via embedded wallet, server-verified after on-chain payment (primary). (2) Brand event rake 30/70, prizes on-chain escrowed (SOL BracketChain/SkillOS pattern, our own escrow PDA on the ER program). (3) Active Tier monthly buy (the 2x/3x/4x ladder drains spendable back into the on-ramp). (4) Ads support line (free tier inline banners + opt-in rewarded video, Nigeria Tier-3 CPM $1-4). (5) Cosmetics store non-NFT (board themes / dice skins / avatar frames, spendable sink). (6) Stake mode rake (small fixed per pot, skilled-first, never pay-to-win). (7) Tournament licence (hosted community/brand events, fee or revenue share).

BUILD ORDER (revenue-first, econ-006 + econ-002/003/004): (S0) point ledgers exist today (lifetime + per-game; spendable balance is next). (S1) Active Tier + multipliers + spendable sink (the money engine). (S2) Earn competitions + brand escrow (30/70 rake). (S3) Monetization rails: on-ramp buy-flow + cosmetics store. (S4) Ads + rewarded video (support line, only after real traffic). (S5) Stake mode rake. (S6) Tournament licence. Each stage gates what we build; nothing is built before its revenue reason exists.- S1 (Active Tier + spendable sink, approved by owner): monthly Active Tier ladder bought from spendable points. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo at 2x, Tier 3 = 2,500 at 3x, Tier 4 = 5,000 at 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400). Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted points (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so sinks drain faster than multipliers mint. Lifetime ledger untouched by spending (global_points is the spendable balance; lifetime_points stays permanent).

S1 implementation notes: new profile columns active_tier (int), active_tier_expires_at (timestamptz), tier_boost_used_today (int), tier_boost_day (date). Client: tiers.js helpers getActiveTierProfile / buyActiveTier / computeWinReward wired into the Ludo win path; header shows tier badge; profile page shows a buy card. Server-authoritative metering is a mainnet security item (security-queue), client-first on devnet.
S2 + Scope C (IN-PROGRESS, owned by the "Earn competitions" roadmap item): on-chain competitions with 30/70 brand rake and an on-chain escrow, plus the parked Scope C finish-order record. Plan:

Scope C (finish-order, the on-chain match result): new PlayerResult PDA (seed `gfgresult`) + initialize_result/delegate_result/record_result on the same delegated gfg-dice program. record_result commits the player's FULL 1st..4th finish order for a match (finish_order [u8;4] plus points/multiplier/match_ref), gasless on the ER (session key signs, 0 SOL). This completes the on-chain match result story: dice rolls -> reward points -> full finish order.

S2 (competitions + escrow): new Competition escrow account (seed `gfgcomp` + sponsor pubkey, ONE active comp per sponsor) + initialize_comp/fund_comp/close_comp/settle_comp/claim_comp on the same program. Brand/sponsor funds the pool on-chain BEFORE the event (prize LOCKED), platform rake 30% / winners 70% split by program logic at settle time (winners_bucket = pool * 7000/10000), winners claim gasless. Proven pattern: BracketChain/SkillOS escrow vaults, own PDA (no third-party custody). On devnet the escrow is devnet SOL (free money) so the lifecycle is proven end-to-end; legal framing (points entry + small fee, pay prizes in points, T&Cs) is a mainnet item.

Relay: handleDelegate gains the result PDA (3 PDAs/player, fresh = 6 steps ~0.013 SOL; per-player cap default 0.012 -> 0.015 SOL); comp lifecycle endpoints (create/fund/close/settle/claim) server-side with the sponsor key (scripts/comp-relay.mjs + /api/comp routes on relay-server.mjs and api/comp.mjs on Vercel).

Client: record_result wired into win-detection (soft-fail, commits the full finish order when all 4 seats finish with a valid proof roll); recordResult + claimComp on window.magicblockDice (gasless ER, session key signs); competitions page (browse/leaderboard/claim, Vite input `/competitions/`, Play-section nav link); dashboard escrow + result-PDA tracking (probe ops.compState + accounts roles).
Devnet is free money: escrow proof-of-life only; server-side entry gating + verified payout become mainnet security items (security-queue, never client-served).

S2/Scope C DONE-VERIFIED (2026-08-14): program deployed (id unchanged, 19 instructions, 4 accounts + WinnerAlloc type); IDL synced; harness scripts/lab/s2-comp-test.mjs proved the full lifecycle live on devnet: create (init+delegate, base layer) -> fund 10,000 (ER gasless) -> close (Open->Funded) -> settle 5,000/1,500/500 of 7,000 bucket (70/30 rake enforced, Settled) -> winner 1 onboarded via relay (3-PDA, ~0.013 SOL) -> claimed 5,000 gasless on the ER (0-SOL player; points PDA credited total=5000, award_count=1, last_reason=2=COMP_WIN) -> double claim REJECTED on-chain (points stayed 5000, claimed=true). Relay GET /api/comp returns live state; POST create/fund/close/settle + claim routes smoke-tested.

UNIVERSAL GAME RESULT SEAM (M2, standalone plug-and-play contract bus): new platform-level bus public/universal/result-seam/game-result.js. Every game ends with one call: window.publishGameResult({gameId, players:[{seat,actor:user|house|local,position|score}], proof:{method,chain,signature}}). The bus validates/normalizes into the canonical gfg:game-result@1 envelope, attaches wallet identity to 'user' seats, and fans the result out via window.onGameResult(handler) + a 'gfg:game-result' DOM event. M3/M4/M7 subscribe to the bus and NEVER read game internals. 50 games = 1 reward plug, 1 competition plug; adding a game = emit the same envelope, the platform does not change. Ludo (ludo-lab) now emits this envelope on match completion (replaces the ad-hoc onGfgMatchResult seam). Architecture.json + AGENTS.md updated: the seam is its OWN module (M2, in-progress) and the module list is renumbered by build order (M1 game core, M2 seam, M3 local points, M4 global ledgers, M5 subscription, M6 point sources, M7 competitions, M8 sponsor escrow).

UNIVERSAL MODULES FOLDER (public/universal/): the platform side of the plug-and-play contract now has one canonical tree. The M2 seam moved to universal/result-seam/game-result.js (games/ludo-lab/index.html + the M1 endgame harness updated; nothing else referenced it). Homed folders now exist for every universal module so future games and modules find each other and update without touching a game: points/ = M3 (local PURE per-game), ledgers/ = M4 (pure/lifetime/spendable), subscription/ = M5 (Active Tier), point-sources/ = M6, competitions/ = M7 (deferred), escrow/ = M8 (optional plugin, deferred). Each folder carries its module contract + status; per-module product work stays gated on module status in architecture.json. Existing profiles.js / tiers.js (referenced by ~25 pages) are not moved; their logic migrates into these folders as the M3/M4/M5 reworks build.

RENDER LOOP FIX (ludo + ludo-lab): the board previously cleared + redrew the whole canvas at 60fps forever because the blink engine's requestAnimationFrame never stopped. Now it only runs while a token is actually blinking; the dice physics loop self-renders its tumble and paints one settled frame, and the canvas goes fully idle (zero rAF) the rest of the time. Fixes CPU/battery thrash and the wipe of transient canvas painting (dice/overlays persisting) that the unconditional redraw caused. Game-state changes redraw via the existing drawLudoLayout calls (turn/movement/persistence/winners) + an ensureBoardAnimationLoop hook in the capture.js wrapper.

VERIFY-LINK HONESTY FIX (ludo + ludo-lab): per-roll "Verify on SolanaFM" links pointed at MagicBlock ER (ephemeral rollup) tx signatures, which NO public explorer indexes (SolanaFM/Solana explorer only index the base chain + settlement), so every click 404'd. Replaced with an honest "Roll resolved on-chain (MagicBlock ER VRF)" status line; the real, linkable base-chain proof (the tx that created + delegated the player's dice account, sponsored by the relay) is surfaced as a working devnet link when it was freshly sponsored (magicblockDice.getLastDiceDelegationSignature). The raw ER receipt stays available in the console for debugging. Rule going forward: never link an ER tx sig on a standard explorer.

SCOPE C IN-GAME WIRING (on-chain match record, admin-only roadmap item "On-chain match record (full finish order)"): the winners ceremony now commits the FULL 1st..4th finish order to the player's on-chain game-record PDA (record_result, gasless ER, session key signs, soft-fail that never blocks the ceremony) and shows a status line with a click-to-copy receipt; when the relay freshly created the result account this session, a working devnet link to that base-layer creation tx is shown too. The program instruction, the relay's result-PDA delegation and the client recordResult already existed and were harness-verified (2026-08-14); the missing piece was the game-level wiring (win-detection commitGameResultOnchain) + the ceremony UX (index.html #result-ceremony-proof, turn.js render, style.css .ceremony-proof).

M3 LOCAL POINTS REWORK (pure + spendable, shipped + deployed devnet 2026-08-16): the PlayerPoints ledger now uses per-game seeds [gfgpoints, game_tag, player] and holds BOTH tracks: local_pure_lifetime (unspendable lifetime wins in that game) and local_spendable_balance (the spendable split, drawn only by that game's own spends). record_points now credits both tracks together on a verified win with a duplicate-match_ref guard; NEW spend_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) decrements spendable only (InsufficientBalance guard); NEW migrate_points(game_tag) is a permissionless, idempotent, base-layer data-preservation instruction that copies the legacy [gfgpoints, player] account's total_points into the tagged ledger as a 1:1 pure/spendable split and leaves the legacy account as a tombstone (never closed - enforced by the solana-upgrade-safety rule). All tracked devnet players migrated live. Relay: POST /api/delegate now accepts gameTag; POST /api/migrate-points runs the on-chain migration (sponsor pays). Client: recordPoints(gameTag, points, reason, matchRef) (legacy 3-arg signature still accepted -> gameTag 'ludo'), fetchPointsPda(gameTag) returns {pure, spendable, ...}, spendLocal(gameTag, amount, reason, spendRef), claimComp(compPda, winnerIndex, gameTag), SPEND_REASONS exposed on window. Profile page on-chain points ledger card now shows pure + spendable. Ludo scoring (owner-locked): 4P 1st=100/2nd=50/3rd=10/4th=0, 2P 1st=100 only, ONLY the 'You' seat earns, house/local seats earn nothing.

ADMIN POINTS RECOVERY TOOL (M3/M4 backfill, dashboard/recovery.html): admin tool for diagnosing and recovering orphaned M3 local points that never credited to M4 global ledgers. Flow: admin searches user by email (Dynamic Management API, source of truth) or wallet address directly. Tool fetches M3 PDAs for all known games (per-game pure, spendable, award_count, last award) and M4 global PDA (pure, lifetime, spendable, game_credit_count). Compares totals: if M3 sum > M4 global pure, orphaned gap detected. Backfill calls record_global_points(kind=0, exact_M3_amount, ...) with program idempotency guard preventing duplicates. Security: admin NEVER types point amounts (auto-read from M3), only ADD path (no subtract/inflate), on-chain DuplicateMatchRef guard prevents double-adds. Server-side proxy for Dynamic user search (api/dynamic-search.mjs on Vercel, /api/dynamic-search on local relay) keeps API key server-side. Mobile-first responsive design. Designed to extend for M6 credits later (signup/referral backfill with same pattern).

A delegated account's ER state lives on EXACTLY ONE region, so the client (src/magicblock-vrf.js) now resolves each account's hosting region via the Router's getDelegationStatus -> fqdn and submits + polls THERE (region-aware targeting; rotation is only a fallback for accounts the Router has not reported yet). entries.title: Verify your game history on-chain
entries.summary: Your profile now shows your real blockchain activity: every roll and win is backed by a Solana transaction you can open and verify yourself.
details: On-chain activity transparency (admin + player views): new server-side Wallets & accounts tracker in scripts/endpoints-probe.mjs (buildAccountsTracker + latestSignatures). It inventories every wallet/PDA the site touches: sponsor/house wallet, house dice PDA (via houseDicePda() with PDA-derivation fallback), and up to 10 sponsored player wallets + their dice PDAs from the spend ledger. Each entry carries its role, a gasless/who-pays note, live SOL balance, real-time ER delegation status from the Magic Router (getDelegationStatus), and the latest on-chain tx signatures from the devnet public RPC (best-effort, 8s timeout, fails open with an error string).

Tracker runs its checks concurrently (Promise.allSettled) so a slow public RPC cannot serialize the whole probe; it builds its own createConnection so it is independent of the main probe connection. Wired into the probe payload as ops.accounts with a { error } fail-safe so a tracker failure never breaks the dashboard.

Admin dashboard (dashboard/index.html) gains a "Wallets & accounts" section: clickable per-account SolanaFM + official-explorer links (via the existing gfg-explorer.js), ER delegation badge, SOL balance, gasless note, and the latest tx links with timestamps. Purple-bordered so it stands apart from the ops panel.

Profile page (profile/index.html) gains "Blockchain identity" (the wallet now carries an on-chain account link) and a new "Your on-chain activity" card that lists the last 8 point_transactions whose match_id is a proof-roll signature (game, reason, points, clickable tx link), so players can open and verify their own rolls and win rewards on-chain.
Verified live on devnet: probe watchlist 8/8 ok; sponsor balance 92.8896 SOL; house dice PDA delegated=true to the ER validator; both carry recent tx signatures.

entries.title: Latency benchmark: ER is the playable path
entries.summary: Measured real dice-roll latency on devnet. MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollup handles dice at ~1.7s (gasless) vs ~4.8s for the paid base-chain queue — and board moves run on the ER at ~10-20ms, invisible to players.
details: built scripts/lab/bench-roll-comparison.mjs (LEG=base|er|web2|all) measuring send->VRF-result on real devnet transactions
ER VRF queue 5hBR57...: avg ~1.7s, p95 ~2.0s (devnet oracle callback dominates)
Base paid queue Cuj97...: avg ~4.8s, p95 ~5.1s — 2.8x slower than ER
Web2 local Math.random: 0.0ms (5000 samples) — the honest baseline row
root cause of earlier bench failure: rollOn passed sponsor as playerAuthority for a PDA keyed to a fresh keypair => ConstraintSeeds(2006); fixed by separating payer vs authority
client already uses the fast ER queue (src/gfg-dice-config.js:25) — no code change needed for the fast path
benchmarks.html added at /games/ludo-lab/benchmarks.html for the marketing/3-way comparison story
Solana mainnet NOW ~75ms avg response (Jonas Hahn, Solana Fdn DevRel, Aug 11 2026); FluxRPC YellowSockets is a base-layer RPC optimization only — does not speed ER rolls

entries.title: Anti-cheat architecture decided: chain-authoritative earn mode
entries.summary: Decided the Play-to-Earn version will validate every move on-chain (consensus-enforced, ~10-20ms), so cheaters can't fake wins or farm rewards. A separate 'Play for Fun' mode stays lightweight for casual players.
details: client-authoritative is a milk-the-sponsor risk once real rewards launch -> chain-authoritative for ALL state-changing moves in earn mode

pattern proven by live open-source projects: Magic UNO (every card play on ER, sub-10ms), DesiDash (every tap 8-18ms, batch commits), WhoRugUs (moves/tasks/votes as signed ER txs, VRF roles, PER for secrets), rock-paper-scissor official example
dice must stay ER VRF (~1.7s) — provability IS the product; hide it inside the existing 3.5s dice animation window
computer turns are just another signer; automation does not create a trust gap
two-version plan: fun (client authority, no financial impact) vs earn (on-chain authority, reward gated on on-chain state)
revert rule if felt latency >~2.5s p95: fall back to local AI rolls + keep ER only for proof roll + final record

roadmap.title: Platform economy: 3-point ledgers, 2 level systems, competitions + brand sponsorships
roadmap.summary: Your points finally have real, lasting value: a lifetime record that never expires, spendable points you can use anywhere, and a per-game record that proves how good you are at each game. Level up to earn multipliers on wins and an ad-free experience, and compete in events with guaranteed, locked-in prizes.
details: REDESIGN (agreed shape at strategy session, design-phase; devnet-safe pieces may ship first, mainnet = revenue phase). Owner framing: honest about limits from day one, never bait-and-switch; points must have sources AND sinks or they carry no value; winners of competitions never pay for their won points.

THREE POINT LEDGERS (all reason-tagged in existing point_transactions audit; Supabase aggregation + on-chain record_points PDA as verifiable layer): (1) GLOBAL LIFETIME - non-spendable, permanent, every point from every source (won/bought/giveaway/referral) accumulates forever, never decays, drives Lifetime Rank + loyal/O.G. rewards (anniversaries). (2) GLOBAL SPENDABLE - the exchange currency, spendable anywhere on the platform: buys Active Tier, cosmetics, competition entries, stakes; goes up and down; this is what purchases top up. (3) LOCAL PER-GAME points - per-game detailed verifiable record of how points were earned (already exists as lifetime Ludo points in local-points.js); drives per-game skill reputation and gates game-specific unlocks.

TWO LEVEL SYSTEMS: (A) Lifetime Rank - permanent, earned (lifetime points + account age, e.g. 5,000 lifetime AND 1 month old -> Rank 2; level-up gates like duration), never drops, never lost, unlocks O.G./legacy rewards and future specials. (B) Active Tier - temporary, monthly, bought from spendable points (current 500 level = Active Tier 2 now; Tier N costs scale up) - paying deducts from spendable balance (1,000 total minus 500 tier cost = 500 left). Multipliers by tier: 2x/3x/4x on win point rewards. Renews monthly or expires: if it lapses MID-competition, access locks but the leaderboard keeps points earned within the window; re-up instantly restores entry.

EARN COMPETITIONS: skilled entry (Active Tier/level gate + small entry fee in spendable points), never pay-to-win - claiming won rewards is free (tennis analogy: pay a little to enter, win covers it, higher wins cover more). Prizes from pooled entries + sponsor/brand top-ups + platform rake.

BRAND-SPONSORED COMPETITIONS (web3-native upsell): brands fund a prize pool for a chosen game + rules; PLATFORM 30% / WINNERS 70%. Prize LOCKED in a smart-contract escrow (PDAs on the ER program, same gfg-dice owner) BEFORE the event, winners claim by program logic automatically - a brand can never promise and then stiff winners (protects our brand). Proven patterns already exist on Solana: BracketChain escrow-vault PDAs, SkillOS permissionless sponsor pools, PYMSTR batch payouts. Build our own escrow PDA to avoid third-party custody.

ADS: inline banners ONLY (no popups/interstitials that break the game), shown on the free tier; upgrading to a higher Active Tier removes ads. Level 1 sees low-fill banner, higher tiers ad-free. Web2 first: Google AdSense H5 Game Ads (easiest start, $8-15 Tier-1 CPM but Tier-3 Nigeria is $1-4 - ads are a support line, not the business), then Ezoic/Playwire/AdinPlay for gaming-optimized fill, web3 (Adshares/BigAds) only when crypto-native demand exists.

PURCHASES: no Stripe, no app stores. Player funds the embedded Dynamic wallet via on-ramp (card/bank in local currency), buys spendable points in-app; points minted SERVER-SIDE only after a verified on-chain payment (security-queue rule - never trust a client-claimed paid flag). This is the buy-to-join moment Ludo King monetizes, early-phase softened by referral/giveaway/social-share earn paths.

OPEN BLIND-SPOTS (from owner review): (1) DOUBLE-CREDIT risk - do NOT let one win credit both local-spendable AND global-spendable (inflation); instead game-exclusives are gated by local lifetime balance + charged from global spendable. (2) MULTIPLIER INFLATION - 2x/3x/4x everywhere mints faster than tiers cost; apply multipliers to base match rewards only (never stake returns) + per-day cap, keep sinks (comp entries, cosmetics) draining faster than multipliers mint. (3) LEGALITY (mainnet-framing) - Ludo is a game of chance; pay-to-enter cash-prize chance games are restricted in several jurisdictions (India notably); keep entry predominantly earned-points + small, pay prizes in points, real value via escrow with clear T&Cs; legal review before mainnet cash comps.

HARD CONSTRAINT: tracks under the Value model (free today, honest about limits) umbrella (approved roadmap item). Anti-abuse hardening (server-authoritative allowance/tier metering, purchase verification, refill farming, multiplier circumvention) lives in docs/changelog/security-queue.md, NEVER client-served.

roadmap.title: Platform economy: revenue-first build order (ledgers -> tier -> comps -> rails)
details: What is on-chain now (two aspects, both devnet + gasless, players hold 0 SOL): (1) DICE - every roll goes through MagicBlock VRF on the ER (human via the player's delegated dice PDA gfgplayerd signed by the session key; computers via the house sponsor key server-side). The roll result plus entropy seed land in the dice PDA and the roll tx signature is the verifiable proof. (2) REWARDS - a 1st-place win that had a valid on-chain roll fires record_points on the player's points PDA (gfgpoints); it stores total_points, award_count, last_points/last_reason/last_match_ref where last_match_ref = first 8 bytes of the winning roll sig, binding the reward to the exact roll. The record_points tx signature is the authoritative receipt. What stays off-chain: board state, token moves, turns, and Supabase profile totals (aggregation/fallback only).

On-chain points (Scope B, implemented + verified live on devnet): new PlayerPoints ledger account (seed gfgpoints) + initialize_points/delegate_points/record_points instructions on the same delegated gfg-dice program (program id unchanged).

Client recordPoints(points, reason, matchRef): pure gasless ER write (session key signs, 0-SOL player) returning the receipt signature; matchRefFromSignature = first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64; fetchPointsPda reads the player's own ledger; POINT_REASONS.WIN_1ST=1.
win-detection: after the Supabase +100 1st-place award (proof roll gated), fires recordPoints(100, 1, matchRef) as a soft-fail mirror that never blocks the win UX, and logs the receipt explorer link.
Admin tracker lists each wallet's dice PDA AND points PDA (live delegation status); dashboard renders both. Profile page adds "Your on-chain points ledger" card (own account only, gasless read).
Supabase stays aggregation/fallback; the on-chain record is the permanent verifiable layer (re-sync on devnet wipe).
Scope C (parked): on-chain finish-order record so a full game result (1st..4th) is also committed, not just the reward points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-003): Active Tier ladder anchored to the 100-pt 1st-place win. Tier 1 free 1x. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo -> 2x. Tier 3 = 2,500 spendable/mo -> 3x. Tier 4 = 5,000 spendable/mo -> 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400), never stake returns / comp prizes / referral gifts. Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted pts (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so whales can't mint infinite points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-006): SEVEN revenue streams that decide the build order (revenue first, features second). (1) On-ramp: buy spendable points via embedded wallet, server-verified after on-chain payment (primary). (2) Brand event rake 30/70, prizes on-chain escrowed (SOL BracketChain/SkillOS pattern, our own escrow PDA on the ER program). (3) Active Tier monthly buy (the 2x/3x/4x ladder drains spendable back into the on-ramp). (4) Ads support line (free tier inline banners + opt-in rewarded video, Nigeria Tier-3 CPM $1-4). (5) Cosmetics store non-NFT (board themes / dice skins / avatar frames, spendable sink). (6) Stake mode rake (small fixed per pot, skilled-first, never pay-to-win). (7) Tournament licence (hosted community/brand events, fee or revenue share).

BUILD ORDER (revenue-first, econ-006 + econ-002/003/004): (S0) point ledgers exist today (lifetime + per-game; spendable balance is next). (S1) Active Tier + multipliers + spendable sink (the money engine). (S2) Earn competitions + brand escrow (30/70 rake). (S3) Monetization rails: on-ramp buy-flow + cosmetics store. (S4) Ads + rewarded video (support line, only after real traffic). (S5) Stake mode rake. (S6) Tournament licence. Each stage gates what we build; nothing is built before its revenue reason exists.

roadmap.title: Match persistence + offline recovery (M1)
roadmap.summary: Your match never disappears on a refresh and a short internet hiccup no longer traps you: you pick up right where you left off, and you are always told clearly when your play can or cannot be recorded.
details: Refresh-safe resume (fixes "refresh starts a fresh game"): removed the beforeunload abandonment that marked ANY reload as abandoned. A reload mid-match now resumes the exact same board (tokens, current turn, mode, locked setup, crowns). Only an in-progress match untouched for 24h+ (a session that truly ended) is treated as abandoned and cleared to fresh setup. Explicit End Match / Reset still abandons as before.

Interrupted-roll recovery: rollDiceEngine now persists isDiceRolled immediately when a roll starts; loading a state where a roll was started but never finalized (isDiceRolled && hasRolledThisTurn && no moves) re-arms the turn so it rolls cleanly instead of hanging on a locked "rolled" flag.

Pending on-chain push queue (backup plan with a per-entry tamper hash): queuePendingPush(type, payload) / flushPendingPushes() in persistence.js. Each entry carries a digest of its own payload; flush re-verifies the digest before pushing via registered handlers (window.registerPendingPushHandler), retries on every page load and every network restore, and DROPS + warns on any tampered entry so an altered play is NEVER recorded on-chain. Ready for M3/M4 reward records.

Tamper/integrity now warns loudly: a digest mismatch on load (console-edited localStorage) shows a visible, dismissible warning popup ("will not be recorded on-chain; fresh match started") instead of failing silently.

Outage pause is now TRUE-outage only (fixes the false banner on refresh): the boot-time verifyChainForResume probe is REMOVED because a ping right after a reload read as "down" even when internet was fine (a slow/blocked RPC from the player's network) and the banner then stuck forever. The banner + pause only ever appear after a REAL on-chain roll attempt fails (3 retries in rollDiceEngine -> enterChainDownState). Recovery is fully covered without the probe: the 8s auto-monitor, the banner "Retry now" button and the saved pre-roll state all share one resumeFromChainDown() path that re-triggers the turn roll on recovery and flushes pending pushes. Refresh-during-outage still works: the board resumes, and the next roll attempt honestly re-pauses if the chain is still down. Banner copy makes clear the match is paused so nothing is falsely recorded.
requestPersistentStorage(): best-effort navigator.storage.persist() so mobile browsers are less likely to evict the save.
Harness: 126/126 (added: stale-match abandon, interrupted-roll re-arm, tamper warning popup flag, pending-push flush + tamper drop). Build green.

roadmap.title: On-chain match record (full finish order)

details: SCOPE C IN-GAME WIRING: the winners ceremony now commits the FULL 1st..4th finish order to the player's on-chain game-record PDA (record_result, gasless ER, session key signs, soft-fail that never blocks the ceremony) and shows a status line with a click-to-copy receipt; when the relay freshly created the result account this session, a working devnet link to that base-layer creation tx is shown too.

Program instruction (record_result + PlayerResult PDA seed gfgresult), relay result-PDA delegation (handleDelegate, 3 PDAs/player) and client recordResult already existed + were harness-verified 2026-08-14; the missing piece was the game-level wiring (win-detection commitGameResultOnchain, proof-bound match_ref from the winning roll sig) + the ceremony UX (index.html #result-ceremony-proof, turn.js render w/ copy-on-click, style.css .ceremony-proof).

Render loop fix (ludo + ludo-lab): board no longer clears+redraws at 60fps forever; blink loop runs only while a token blinks, dice physics self-renders its tumble + one settled frame, canvas idle otherwise. Fixes CPU/battery thrash + wiped transient canvas painting.

Verify-link honesty fix (ludo + ludo-lab): ER (ephemeral rollup) tx sigs aren't indexed by any public explorer, so per-roll SolanaFM links 404'd. Replaced with an honest 'resolved on-chain (MagicBlock ER VRF)' line + the linkable base-chain tx (dice-account create/delegate) via magicblockDice.getLastDiceDelegationSignature. roadmap.title: On-chain receipt explorer (verify any game receipt)
roadmap.summary: See the blockchain proof yourself. Copy any match receipt from the winners screen, paste it into the explorer, and watch it resolve as a confirmed transaction with the exact result the game showed you. You can check every claim, any time.
details: Module: M1 (proof-of-play tooling, game-adjacent - NOT a universal module, so it does NOT live in public/universal/). Same build for every M1A game (Ludo now, Ayo Olopon later): it proves the game's own rolls/matches on-chain, it is not a reward/competition consumer.
New public page /verify/ (Vite input verify): anyone can paste a GameFolkGames receipt (or any Solana id) and get an honest on-chain answer.

Why: ER receipt signatures are NOT indexed by public explorers (SolanaFM/Solana see only the base chain + settlement), so the copyable ceremony receipt had no public lookup. This page is the real verification path: it queries MagicBlock ER RPC directly (getTransaction on devnet-us.magicblock.app) AND the base devnet RPC (api.devnet.solana.com).

Signature lookup: queries both ledgers. Found on base = permanent record with a working solana.fm link. Found on ER only = rollup execution, formatted readably (success/fail, fee, slot, time, Anchor Instruction: names from logMessages, programs invoked, involved accounts as chips). Neither = honest not-found card explaining rollup ephemerality and offering the account path.

Account lookup: getSignaturesForAddress on the ER (recent rollup sigs, each clickable) plus an ALWAYS-present working base-explorer (solana.fm) account link, because the one-time create+delegate transactions on the base chain are the permanent proof the account was really opened. One delegated session + one sign-in wallet covers every game on the same program, so a single onboarding tx is the proof; the page says so in plain language.
Auto-fill: /verify/?tx=<sig> (and ?account=) pre-fill the search bar and auto-run the query.

Win popup (ludo-lab, ceremony): the copyable receipt gains a small See on-chain receipt link that opens /verify/?tx=<receipt> in a new tab (keeps the popup uncluttered). The existing sponsored onboarding tx link below the receipt is kept unchanged.
Honesty rules kept: no fake links (never a Google/explorer link to an ER sig), no new security-sensitive data served to the client, devnet-only at this phase.

roadmap.title: Local points ledger: pure + spendable per game, on-chain (M3)
roadmap.summary: Your points in each game get two permanent on-chain records: a lifetime score you can be proud of and a spendable balance you can use on that game's extras. Only real, verifiable wins count, and only you can earn them.
details: Module: M3 (local points, per game, PURE + SPENDABLE, on-chain via ER). FIRST universal consumer of the M2 result seam - it proves the bus end-to-end. Owner-locked 2026-08-16 (D1/D2/D3).

TWO-TRACK ledger per game per player: LOCAL PURE (unspendable lifetime, undiluted, the native-game bragging-rights source of truth) + LOCAL SPENDABLE (spendable split of the same wins, drawn down only by that game's own in-game spends). ONE PDA holds both: seed [gfgpoints, game_tag, player].

PROGRAM DECISION (no new program): extend the existing delegated gfg program (game_tag is data, not code). MagicBlock public ER = gasless (tx fee 0; only session 0.0003 SOL at undelegation + commit 0.0001 SOL, paid by the sponsor, never the user). One delegated program = one ER session = one onboarding fee per player (~0.0086 SOL); every record_points/spend_local after that is FREE. A separate program would force a second delegation + second onboarding per player per game - unsustainable for 50+ games. Modularity lives in the M3 module (public/universal/points/) + game_tag seeds.

PROGRAM REWORK (same id, anchor build + redeploy): PlayerPoints gains pure_lifetime + spendable_balance + spend_count/last_spend_ref/last_spend_ts; seeds become [gfgpoints, game_tag, authority] on initialize_points/delegate_points; record_points(game_tag, points, reason, match_ref) credits BOTH tracks on a verified win; NEW spend_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) decrements spendable ONLY (InsufficientBalance guard), gasless on ER.
RELAY: handleDelegate creates + delegates the tagged points PDA (ludo now) alongside dice + result PDAs, idempotent; spend ledger/caps unchanged.
CLIENT (src/magicblock-vrf.js): recordPoints(points, reason, matchRef, gameTag='ludo'), fetchPointsPda(gameTag), NEW spendLocal(gameTag, amount, reason, spendRef).

SCORING (D1, Ludo - config in the M3 module, NOT the game): 4P 1st=100 / 2nd=50 / 3rd=10 / 4th=0 (game auto-ends at 3 winners, 4th earns nothing); 2P 1st=100 only (auto-ends at 1st, 2nd earns nothing). ONLY the 'You' (user) seat earns at its own position; house/local seats never. Mode derived from envelope players[].length - no M2 change.
GATING: valid envelope proof signature required to bank; match_ref = first 8 bytes of the winning roll sig; idempotent by match_ref (module set + localStorage + program last_match_ref guard).
NO DILUTION: local pure NEVER receives signup/purchase/referral/giveaway/multiplier (those are M6 -> M4 only).

MODULE public/universal/points/ (game-agnostic): subscribes window.onGameResult, computes award from its per-game scoring config, banks via recordPoints(gameTag), exposes window.localPoints { get(gameTag), spend(gameTag, amount, reason, ref), subscribe(cb) }, fills data-local-points-pure/spendable slots. A new game = add its scoring table + emit the seam; no game-side reward code.
ludo-lab hosts the local-points display slot; the game ships NO reward code (already clean). Legacy public/games/ludo/ untouched (D3).
RECOVERY: Supabase backup is a later step (devnet-wipe restore); on-chain records replayable by game_tag/reason/match_ref.

TEST (benchmark = this spec): module harness (2P/4P x user 1st..4th x house/local seats -> exact 100/50/10/0, user-only, idempotency, spend_local) + on-chain ER harness (gasless record_points + spend_local from a 0-SOL session key).

SHIPPED 2026-08-16 (harness-verified): on-chain ER harness scripts/er-points-harness.mjs PASS - record_points +spend_local gasless on the ER from a 0-SOL player (sponsor signs): pure/spendable 0->150->300, spend_local 40 -> spendable 260, pure untouched, award_count correct. M3 module harness scripts/m3-module-harness.mjs 17/17 PASS against the locked scoring spec (4P 100/50/10/0, 2P 100/0, user-only, no-proof gate, duplicate match_ref single-bank, spend_local spendable-only).

migrate_points BUG FIXED + REDEPLOYED 2026-08-16: an intermediate pre-deploy build zeroed legacy [gfgpoints, player] ledgers instead of copying them (read-before-write ordering). Root cause fixed in the current build (read legacy fully first, copy to tagged, tombstone), redeployed (ELF byte-verified) and re-verified live: re-running migration on restored ledgers is a clean no-op (guard: destination award_count>0 -> skip; never zeroes).

RESTORE TOOL scripts/restore-points.mjs (new): data-preservation restore for wiped/zeroed ledgers. Explicit mode (<wallet>=<points>...) credits the tagged ledger via record_points (ER, sponsor signs, skip-guard on existing balance); --from-supabase mode rebuilds from point_transactions via profiles.solana_wallet. Used to restore the 3 orphaned legacy ledgers zeroed by the buggy build (400/200/5000, verified on-chain: pure=spendable=value, award_count=1; re-run SKIPs).

DISPLAY WIRING (shipped): M3 module now exposes lastAward + notifies subscribers with (gameTag, ledger, award) and re-fetches on gfg:auth-changed; global header chip feeds live from window.localPoints via initGlobalHeader({localPointsTag}) (ludo-lab opts in: Local: N chip, gasless read); ludo-lab win ceremony shows "+N Ludo points banked on-chain" the moment the award lands; client exposes magicblockDice.pointsPda(gameTag) so the profile on-chain ledger card works.

REST (remaining in M3): browser end-to-end (login -> win -> bank -> header/ceremony/profile update), spendable sink UI (S3 shop) draw, and the OFFICIAL display-source switch (global pill -> on-chain) when Supabase is retired.

roadmap.title: Admin Points Recovery Tool
roadmap.summary: Support tool for resolving missing points: if a player wins on-chain but the global ledger missed it, admin can look up their account, see exactly what happened, and fix it in one click (all gasless, no manual point entry). Players keep their full earn record across every game.
details: What is on-chain now (two aspects, both devnet + gasless, players hold 0 SOL): (1) DICE - every roll goes through MagicBlock VRF on the ER (human via the player's delegated dice PDA gfgplayerd signed by the session key; computers via the house sponsor key server-side). The roll result plus entropy seed land in the dice PDA and the roll tx signature is the verifiable proof. (2) REWARDS - a 1st-place win that had a valid on-chain roll fires record_points on the player's points PDA (gfgpoints); it stores total_points, award_count, last_points/last_reason/last_match_ref where last_match_ref = first 8 bytes of the winning roll sig, binding the reward to the exact roll. The record_points tx signature is the authoritative receipt. What stays off-chain: board state, token moves, turns, and Supabase profile totals (aggregation/fallback only).

On-chain points (Scope B, implemented + verified live on devnet): new PlayerPoints ledger account (seed gfgpoints) + initialize_points/delegate_points/record_points instructions on the same delegated gfg-dice program (program id unchanged).

Relay handleDelegate now creates AND delegates BOTH per-player PDAs (dice gfgplayerd + points gfgpoints) in one idempotent call; fresh onboarding = 4 steps ~0.0086 SOL; per-player spend cap default raised 0.005 -> 0.012 SOL (covers two PDAs with margin).

Client recordPoints(points, reason, matchRef): pure gasless ER write (session key signs, 0-SOL player) returning the receipt signature; matchRefFromSignature = first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64; fetchPointsPda reads the player's own ledger; POINT_REASONS.WIN_1ST=1.
win-detection: after the Supabase +100 1st-place award (proof roll gated), fires recordPoints(100, 1, matchRef) as a soft-fail mirror that never blocks the win UX, and logs the receipt explorer link.
Admin tracker lists each wallet's dice PDA AND points PDA (live delegation status); dashboard renders both. Profile page adds "Your on-chain points ledger" card (own account only, gasless read).
Supabase stays aggregation/fallback; the on-chain record is the permanent verifiable layer (re-sync on devnet wipe).
Scope C (parked): on-chain finish-order record so a full game result (1st..4th) is also committed, not just the reward points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-003): Active Tier ladder anchored to the 100-pt 1st-place win. Tier 1 free 1x. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo -> 2x. Tier 3 = 2,500 spendable/mo -> 3x. Tier 4 = 5,000 spendable/mo -> 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400), never stake returns / comp prizes / referral gifts. Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted pts (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so whales can't mint infinite points.

DECIDED (2026-08-14, econ-006): SEVEN revenue streams that decide the build order (revenue first, features second). (1) On-ramp: buy spendable points via embedded wallet, server-verified after on-chain payment (primary). (2) Brand event rake 30/70, prizes on-chain escrowed (SOL BracketChain/SkillOS pattern, our own escrow PDA on the ER program). (3) Active Tier monthly buy (the 2x/3x/4x ladder drains spendable back into the on-ramp). (4) Ads support line (free tier inline banners + opt-in rewarded video, Nigeria Tier-3 CPM $1-4). (5) Cosmetics store non-NFT (board themes / dice skins / avatar frames, spendable sink). (6) Stake mode rake (small fixed per pot, skilled-first, never pay-to-win). (7) Tournament licence (hosted community/brand events, fee or revenue share).

BUILD ORDER (revenue-first, econ-006 + econ-002/003/004): (S0) point ledgers exist today (lifetime + per-game; spendable balance is next). (S1) Active Tier + multipliers + spendable sink (the money engine). (S2) Earn competitions + brand escrow (30/70 rake). (S3) Monetization rails: on-ramp buy-flow + cosmetics store. (S4) Ads + rewarded video (support line, only after real traffic). (S5) Stake mode rake. (S6) Tournament licence. Each stage gates what we build; nothing is built before its revenue reason exists.- S1 (Active Tier + spendable sink, approved by owner): monthly Active Tier ladder bought from spendable points. Tier 2 = 1,000 spendable/mo at 2x, Tier 3 = 2,500 at 3x, Tier 4 = 5,000 at 4x. Multiplier applies ONLY to base match win points (100 -> 200/300/400). Per-day multiplier cap +1,000 boosted points (about 10 extra 100-pt wins) so sinks drain faster than multipliers mint. Lifetime ledger untouched by spending (global_points is the spendable balance; lifetime_points stays permanent).

S1 implementation notes: new profile columns active_tier (int), active_tier_expires_at (timestamptz), tier_boost_used_today (int), tier_boost_day (date). Client: tiers.js helpers getActiveTierProfile / buyActiveTier / computeWinReward wired into the Ludo win path; header shows tier badge; profile page shows a buy card. Server-authoritative metering is a mainnet security item (security-queue), client-first on devnet.
S2 + Scope C (IN-PROGRESS, owned by the "Earn competitions" roadmap item): on-chain competitions with 30/70 brand rake and an on-chain escrow, plus the parked Scope C finish-order record. Plan:

Scope C (finish-order, the on-chain match result): new PlayerResult PDA (seed `gfgresult`) + initialize_result/delegate_result/record_result on the same delegated gfg-dice program. record_result commits the player's FULL 1st..4th finish order for a match (finish_order [u8;4] plus points/multiplier/match_ref), gasless on the ER (session key signs, 0 SOL). This completes the on-chain match result story: dice rolls -> reward points -> full finish order.

S2 (competitions + escrow): new Competition escrow account (seed `gfgcomp` + sponsor pubkey, ONE active comp per sponsor) + initialize_comp/fund_comp/close_comp/settle_comp/claim_comp on the same program. Brand/sponsor funds the pool on-chain BEFORE the event (prize LOCKED), platform rake 30% / winners 70% split by program logic at settle time (winners_bucket = pool * 7000/10000), winners claim gasless. Proven pattern: BracketChain/SkillOS escrow vaults, own PDA (no third-party custody). On devnet the escrow is devnet SOL (free money) so the lifecycle is proven end-to-end; legal framing (points entry + small fee, pay prizes in points, T&Cs) is a mainnet item.

Relay: handleDelegate gains the result PDA (3 PDAs/player, fresh = 6 steps ~0.013 SOL; per-player cap default 0.012 -> 0.015 SOL); comp lifecycle endpoints (create/fund/close/settle/claim) server-side with the sponsor key (scripts/comp-relay.mjs + /api/comp routes on relay-server.mjs and api/comp.mjs on Vercel).

Client: record_result wired into win-detection (soft-fail, commits the full finish order when all 4 seats finish with a valid proof roll); recordResult + claimComp on window.magicblockDice (gasless ER, session key signs); competitions page (browse/leaderboard/claim, Vite input `/competitions/`, Play-section nav link); dashboard escrow + result-PDA tracking (probe ops.compState + accounts roles).
Devnet is free money: escrow proof-of-life only; server-side entry gating + verified payout become mainnet security items (security-queue, never client-served).

S2/Scope C DONE-VERIFIED (2026-08-14): program deployed (id unchanged, 19 instructions, 4 accounts + WinnerAlloc type); IDL synced; harness scripts/lab/s2-comp-test.mjs proved the full lifecycle live on devnet: create (init+delegate, base layer) -> fund 10,000 (ER gasless) -> close (Open->Funded) -> settle 5,000/1,500/500 of 7,000 bucket (70/30 rake enforced, Settled) -> winner 1 onboarded via relay (3-PDA, ~0.013 SOL) -> claimed 5,000 gasless on the ER (0-SOL player; points PDA credited total=5000, award_count=1, last_reason=2=COMP_WIN) -> double claim REJECTED on-chain (points stayed 5000, claimed=true). Relay GET /api/comp returns live state; POST create/fund/close/settle + claim routes smoke-tested.

UNIVERSAL GAME RESULT SEAM (M2, standalone plug-and-play contract bus): new platform-level bus public/universal/result-seam/game-result.js. Every game ends with one call: window.publishGameResult({gameId, players:[{seat,actor:user|house|local,position|score}], proof:{method,chain,signature}}). The bus validates/normalizes into the canonical gfg:game-result@1 envelope, attaches wallet identity to 'user' seats, and fans the result out via window.onGameResult(handler) + a 'gfg:game-result' DOM event. M3/M4/M7 subscribe to the bus and NEVER read game internals. 50 games = 1 reward plug, 1 competition plug; adding a game = emit the same envelope, the platform does not change. Ludo (ludo-lab) now emits this envelope on match completion (replaces the ad-hoc onGfgMatchResult seam). Architecture.json + AGENTS.md updated: the seam is its OWN module (M2, in-progress) and the module list is renumbered by build order (M1 game core, M2 seam, M3 local points, M4 global ledgers, M5 subscription, M6 point sources, M7 competitions, M8 sponsor escrow).

UNIVERSAL MODULES FOLDER (public/universal/): the platform side of the plug-and-play contract now has one canonical tree. The M2 seam moved to universal/result-seam/game-result.js (games/ludo-lab/index.html + the M1 endgame harness updated; nothing else referenced it). Homed folders now exist for every universal module so future games and modules find each other and update without touching a game: points/ = M3 (local PURE per-game), ledgers/ = M4 (pure/lifetime/spendable), subscription/ = M5 (Active Tier), point-sources/ = M6, competitions/ = M7 (deferred), escrow/ = M8 (optional plugin, deferred). Each folder carries its module contract + status; per-module product work stays gated on module status in architecture.json. Existing profiles.js / tiers.js (referenced by ~25 pages) are not moved; their logic migrates into these folders as the M3/M4/M5 reworks build.

RENDER LOOP FIX (ludo + ludo-lab): the board previously cleared + redrew the whole canvas at 60fps forever because the blink engine's requestAnimationFrame never stopped. Now it only runs while a token is actually blinking; the dice physics loop self-renders its tumble and paints one settled frame, and the canvas goes fully idle (zero rAF) the rest of the time. Fixes CPU/battery thrash and the wipe of transient canvas painting (dice/overlays persisting) that the unconditional redraw caused. Game-state changes redraw via the existing drawLudoLayout calls (turn/movement/persistence/winners) + an ensureBoardAnimationLoop hook in the capture.js wrapper.

VERIFY-LINK HONESTY FIX (ludo + ludo-lab): per-roll "Verify on SolanaFM" links pointed at MagicBlock ER (ephemeral rollup) tx signatures, which NO public explorer indexes (SolanaFM/Solana explorer only index the base chain + settlement), so every click 404'd. Replaced with an honest "Roll resolved on-chain (MagicBlock ER VRF)" status line; the real, linkable base-chain proof (the tx that created + delegated the player's dice account, sponsored by the relay) is surfaced as a working devnet link when it was freshly sponsored (magicblockDice.getLastDiceDelegationSignature). The raw ER receipt stays available in the console for debugging. Rule going forward: never link an ER tx sig on a standard explorer.

SCOPE C IN-GAME WIRING (on-chain match record, admin-only roadmap item "On-chain match record (full finish order)"): the winners ceremony now commits the FULL 1st..4th finish order to the player's on-chain game-record PDA (record_result, gasless ER, session key signs, soft-fail that never blocks the ceremony) and shows a status line with a click-to-copy receipt; when the relay freshly created the result account this session, a working devnet link to that base-layer creation tx is shown too. The program instruction, the relay's result-PDA delegation and the client recordResult already existed and were harness-verified (2026-08-14); the missing piece was the game-level wiring (win-detection commitGameResultOnchain) + the ceremony UX (index.html #result-ceremony-proof, turn.js render, style.css .ceremony-proof).

M3 LOCAL POINTS REWORK (pure + spendable, shipped + deployed devnet 2026-08-16): the PlayerPoints ledger now uses per-game seeds [gfgpoints, game_tag, player] and holds BOTH tracks: local_pure_lifetime (unspendable lifetime wins in that game) and local_spendable_balance (the spendable split, drawn only by that game's own spends). record_points now credits both tracks together on a verified win with a duplicate-match_ref guard; NEW spend_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) decrements spendable only (InsufficientBalance guard); NEW migrate_points(game_tag) is a permissionless, idempotent, base-layer data-preservation instruction that copies the legacy [gfgpoints, player] account's total_points into the tagged ledger as a 1:1 pure/spendable split and leaves the legacy account as a tombstone (never closed - enforced by the solana-upgrade-safety rule). All tracked devnet players migrated live. Relay: POST /api/delegate now accepts gameTag; POST /api/migrate-points runs the on-chain migration (sponsor pays). Client: recordPoints(gameTag, points, reason, matchRef) (legacy 3-arg signature still accepted -> gameTag 'ludo'), fetchPointsPda(gameTag) returns {pure, spendable, ...}, spendLocal(gameTag, amount, reason, spendRef), claimComp(compPda, winnerIndex, gameTag), SPEND_REASONS exposed on window. Profile page on-chain points ledger card now shows pure + spendable. Ludo scoring (owner-locked): 4P 1st=100/2nd=50/3rd=10/4th=0, 2P 1st=100 only, ONLY the 'You' seat earns, house/local seats earn nothing.

ADMIN POINTS RECOVERY TOOL (M3/M4 backfill, dashboard/recovery.html): admin tool for diagnosing and recovering orphaned M3 local points that never credited to M4 global ledgers. Flow: admin searches user by email (Dynamic Management API, source of truth) or wallet address directly. Tool fetches M3 PDAs for all known games (per-game pure, spendable, award_count, last award) and M4 global PDA (pure, lifetime, spendable, game_credit_count). Compares totals: if M3 sum > M4 global pure, orphaned gap detected. Backfill calls record_global_points(kind=0, exact_M3_amount, ...) with program idempotency guard preventing duplicates. Security: admin NEVER types point amounts (auto-read from M3), only ADD path (no subtract/inflate), on-chain DuplicateMatchRef guard prevents double-adds. Server-side proxy for Dynamic user search (api/dynamic-search.mjs on Vercel, /api/dynamic-search on local relay) keeps API key server-side. Mobile-first responsive design. Designed to extend for M6 credits later (signup/referral backfill with same pattern).

roadmap.title: Level 3 (3x) plan
roadmap.summary: A premium Level 3 plan that triples win points, gives 15 lives a day and a 300-point daily reward, and boosts your final competition score by 50%, all ad-free.
details: CONFIG-DRIVEN PLAN LADDER (owner 2026-08-22): more levels are data, never code.

Level 3 (3x) launch spec: actual $20, discounted $10 / N13,500, Nigeria N8,000. Multiplier 3x (100P base win -> 300P at M4 flow-up). 15 lives/day + 300P/day daily reward (M10 ladder free 5/L2 10/L3 15 lives; 25/200/300P daily).

Earn-competition 1.5x FINAL-POINTS boost (R17): for L3-active players the final ranking column = Total Points x 1.5; L2 = x1.0; L1 = excluded from the leaderboard (not removed). Boost re-reads the live subscription at every render and at the final freeze.
Activation premium-point cost for L3 not yet locked (proposed 10,000P, more than L2's 5,000P). Unit economics: 10,000P = $20 actual / $10 discount at the $0.002/pt base (discounted to match cash).

Ad-free Level 3 (owner 2026-08-22): active Level-3 users never get Monetag ads (tag suppressed sitewide + push service-workers unregistered); Level 1 and Level 2 keep ads so the no-ads upgrade is visible.
